mentions.text: BREAKING: Nasdaq will add $ALAB, $CRWV, $NBIS, $RKLB, and $TER to the Nasdaq-100 effective June 22, 2026, while removing $CHTR, $CTSH, $INSM, $VRSK, and $ZS as part of its quarterly rebalance.

THE NASDAQ 100 $QQQ IS REBALANCING

These 5 names are being added to the index:

Nebius $NBIS
Rocket Lab $RKLB
CoreWeave $CRWV 
Astera Labs $ALAB 
Teradyne $TER 

These 5 names are being removed from the index:

Charter $CHTR
Cognizant $CTSH 
Insmed $INSM
Verisk $VRSK 
Zscaler $ZS
